title: BUGFIX — Achiri /health returns 'degraded' when Anthropic key set but Ollama down
rationale: run-all-tests.ts shows 16/17 passing — HTTP API test fails because GET /health returns status='degraded' when Ollama is unavailable, even when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set (which enables cloud-tier chat). The health logic on line 105 of agents/achiri/server.ts only checks ollama_ready. Fix: status = (ollama_ready || !!ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) ? 'ok' : 'degraded'. This restores 17/17 tests for the Apr 25 alpha pre-launch suite.

tasks.description: In agents/achiri/server.ts, line 105, change: `const status = ollama_ready ? 'ok' : 'degraded';` to: `const status = (ollama_ready || !!process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) ? 'ok' : 'degraded';`. Also update the comment on line 82 from '// Check Ollama model availability (required capability)' to '// Check inference availability: Ollama (free tier) OR Anthropic (paid tiers)'. Do NOT change any other lines.
